svg.title: Outage risk from short outages
svg.desc: Animated: a schematic drone ignores its positioning fixes while the base stations keep sweeping, and its estimate drifts away from the reference. Real offline data from one public-dataset flight: 127 short 1-1.5 s outages build a ladder of drift, a 3 s abort limit is predicted from them, and 5 of 51 held-out 3 s outages exceed it, against 49 (datasheet noise) and 48 (fitted noise) of 51 for the simulators' limits. Below: the share of outages beyond each limit on six public datasets.
svg.text: In flight, a drone briefly ignores its positioning
while the system keeps a reference, so drift is
measured directly. Its own safe 1–1.5 s outages
predict its longer ones; simulators misjudge them.
real drift data from a public flight log · scene schematic
